description: Project scaffolding: Create the Next.js app with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase client libraries, database types, migration SQL files, middleware for auth, and the complete project configuration. This is the foundation that all other features build upon.
steps: Initialize a Next.js 14+ project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ESLint, and App Router in /projects/sandbox/pagina-trabajo/ (use npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --use-npm --import-alias '@/*')

Create src/types/database.ts with TypeScript types for the database schema: profiles table (id uuid, email text, name text, role 'ceo'|'developer', avatar_url text|null) and submissions table (id uuid, developer_id uuid, title text, description text|null, file_url text|null, file_type 'pdf'|'image'|'video'|'note', status 'pending'|'approved'|'rejected', created_at timestamp)
Create src/lib/supabase/client.ts - browser Supabase client using createBrowserClient from @supabase/ssr
Create src/lib/supabase/server.ts - server Supabase client using createServerClient from @supabase/ssr with cookies()
Create src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts - middleware helper that refreshes auth session
Create src/middleware.ts that uses the middleware helper to protect routes (redirect unauthenticated users to /login, redirect authenticated users away from /login to /dashboard)
Create .env.local.example with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholders

Create supabase/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql with: profiles table, submissions table, RLS policies (developers can only read/insert their own submissions, CEO can read all and update status), storage bucket 'work-evidence' setup
Create supabase/seed.sql with sample data: 1 CEO account and 4 developer accounts with profile entries
Configure tailwind.config.ts for dark mode ('class' strategy) with custom color palette suitable for a dark gaming-studio theme
Update src/app/layout.tsx with dark theme (dark background, light text), proper metadata (title: 'Game Dev Work Review'), and the Inter/custom font
Create src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and custom dark theme styles
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
Middleware is configured to handle auth redirects
SQL migration file contains valid Supabase schema with RLS policies
Environment variable template exists with required Supabase keys
Tailwind is configured with dark theme as default
verification: Run npm install and confirm no errors
Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation with zero errors
